title: Zoology :Endocrine Glands Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Endocrine System Chapter

cards.q: Who is known as the Father of Endocrine Glands?
Who coined the term 'Hormones' and in what year?
Which gland is known as the 'Master Gland' or 'Ring Master of the Orchestra'?
What are the effects of hypersecretion of STH (Growth Hormone) in adults?
Hyposecretion of Vasopressin (ADH) leads to which condition characterized by polyuria and polydipsia?
Hypothyroidism in children results in which condition characterized by low IQ and deformed bones?
Which disease is caused by hyperthyroidism in adults?
What are the '3F' and '4S' associated with Adrenaline?
cards.a: 3F: Fear, Fight, Flight. 4S: Sugar metabolism, Salt retaining, Sex hormone, Source of energy.

cards.q: Which hormone is known as the 'Pregnancy hormone' or 'Anti-abortion hormone'?
Which hormone relaxes the pubic symphysis and pelvic girdle to make childbirth easy?
The Pineal body represents the vestige of which organ and what hormone does it secrete?
cards.a: Vestige of the 3rd eye; secretes Melatonin.

cards.q: Which endocrine gland is partly lymphoid, produces T-cells, and contains Hassell's corpuscles?
Which specific cells in the Pancreas produce Insulin and Glucagon respectively?
cards.a: Beta cells produce Insulin; Alpha cells produce Glucagon.

cards.q: What is the normal fasting blood glucose level?
Who discovered the molecular structure of Insulin and won a Nobel Prize for it in 1954?
